description: Original thin antique-gold Myanmar Kanote horizontal divider. Refined carved flourishes, balanced margins, scalable strokes/paths. Transparent outside lines, no text.
Original antique-gold Kanote corner relief, detailed but thin enough for event/form cards. Open negative space, reusable as mirrored CSS corners.
A single pink lotus-inspired royal-garden blossom with natural green leaves and finely engraved painterly edge, isolated with true alpha.
A graceful cluster of small white jasmine flowers and warm sage foliage, true alpha, painterly sunset highlight.
Vertical transition vine for overlapping section seams, lotus and jasmine, warm gold-tinted leaves. Left-edge anchor and seamless visual fade at ends; may be mirrored sparingly.
Illustrated ivory/blush invitation parchment background, warm top glow continuing from Section 1, soft readable center; no printed wording.
Standalone refined Myanmar Kanote ceremonial header in antique gold with lotus accents; crown intact and central text corridor unobstructed.
Tall left-side pink lotus, jasmine and sage foliage border; delicate engraved petals; cropped neither stem nor blossoms.
Complementary but deliberately non-identical right floral border, same scale/light direction, clear central negative space.
Small ornamental lower flourish in antique gold with restrained blush blossoms linking into Section 3.
Cinematic illustrated royal portrait garden with warm sunset-to-ivory atmosphere, subtle ornate architecture, clear real-photo zones; NO people baked in.
Standalone ornate gold portrait frame, actual transparent empty opening for replaceable photos, realistic frame thickness and complete silhouette.
Myanmar carved ceremonial upper arch with antique-gold finesse and completely transparent interior.
Graceful floral/gold upper canopy layer with naturally hinged hanging leaves, suitable for subtle independent sway.
Left lotus/jasmine foreground branch and foliage, naturally anchored for parallax; clean transparent canvas.
Right complementary botanical branch, same painted lighting, independent anchor, not just a mirrored duplicate.
Painted lake/garden lower-edge finishing layer with naturally fading edges into Section 4 parchment. Coordinate its alpha and seam with base plate.
Top illustration of extendable ivory event parchment with fine gold trim and a lower edge seamless against a plain shared ivory texture.
Independent fine-engraved Burmese royal card arch, gold scrollwork, clear open center for date and venue text.
Small lotus and jasmine botanical Kanote corner embellishment for event cards. Transparent and scalable.
Bottom edge of Section 4 extendable parchment, soft ivory-to-blush transition, matches approved top/paper treatment and Section 5.
Seamless champagne-ivory paper texture for vertically growing timeline section; no text or pre-drawn schedule.
Gold-and-blush scrollwork at top of timeline; bridges gently from previous event parchment.
Single vertical lotus/jasmine branch to sway near timeline edge, never over printed schedule entries.
Ornamental antique-gold relief/seal, blank with no initials, date or meaningful text.
Lower decorative gold and blush flourish transitioning to dress code, crisp transparent edges.
Soft ivory/blush repeatable textured background, clean for real CSS color swatches and labels.
Fine antique-gold ceremonial ornament at top; clear title area, shallow and light.
Lotus and jasmine floral side cluster with warm sage/gold leaves; distinct movable decoration.
Restrained lower gold and floral border, transitions naturally into gallery.
Warm blush-ivory parchment texture for gallery, repeatable to variable photo count.
Reusable elegant antique-gold frame; center is actually transparent to show configurable customer photos; no sample photo embedded.
Left gallery border of pink lotus/white jasmine and sage foliage, delicate and not visually distracting from photos.
Complementary unique right gallery border of garden flowers, same lighting and weight.
Subtle warm-ivory extendable paper for gift cards, no product images and NO bank/payment detail.
Original thin, ornate Myanmar Kanote rectangular card border that scales without clipping, transparent open center.
Independent botanical lotus/jasmine flourish suitable for one corner of gift card, never obscuring buttons.
Blush-and-antique gold header arrangement replacing original plum mood. No text, products, payment claims.
Formal ivory/soft-blush RSVP parchment, seamless repeatable center, blank for actual form inputs.
Slim antique-gold engraved header; upper form heading area open and easy to read.
Small true-alpha lotus/jasmine cluster positioned outside interactive form controls.
Soft blush-gold lower transition flourish leading into the final golden garden.
New peaceful golden Myanmar pagoda garden and reflective lake with romantic pastel sunset, architectural continuity with Section 1, clear area for real closing copy. Not a duplicate image.
Transparent ceremonial closing gateway/arch, refined ornate antique-gold Burmese carving, text center fully open.
Painterly lotus and jasmine left-side foreground; clean complete silhouette for gentle parallax.
Matching but distinct right-side botanical foreground with intentional perspective.
Small ornate antique gold farewell flourish, no words or initials, able to animate gently.
